title: Malicious code in modelsdesk (npm)
description: The npm package 'modelsdesk' version 0.4.2 contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but due to the extent of control given to the attacker, complete remediation cannot be guaranteed by removal alone.
